detail.longDescription: Plug-and-play managed agent harnesses in your product: Codex, Claude Code and Hermes through one API on your infrastructure, now open sourced under Apache 2.0. Switch harnesses without rebuilding your backend. Sessions, streaming, files, artifacts, cancellation, failure recovery, all handled. Model provider keys, state, and deliveries under your control. Gateway, Runner, Console in one Docker container. Ready-to-use starter kit apps as inspiration of possibilities.
